name: new_dungeons
objective: Which one is your favorite so far? Source: Blizzard.
pages: Beneath Ironforge. The tomb of the dwarven kings, invaded by suspected Dark Iron dwarves. Alliance enter from their capital.
The ruined city above the Undercity. The Forsaken are retaking it while a necromancer gathers power.
Wetlands, near Thelgen Rock and Dun Algaz. A strange mist and a time-frozen area full of titan constructs.
Alterac Mountains. Needs an attunement: "An Alarming Request" in Southshore or "Key to the City" in Tarren Mill. Enter through the sewers.
Off Stranglethorn, west of Grom'gol. Dive to find the entrance. Trolls, naga and a storm that builds to the last fight.
An ogre fortress in the Riverglades with workshops and camps. Strange chanting after nightfall.
Alcaz Island, Dustwallow Marsh. Defias and naga at war inside; rumored prisoners include King Varian Wrynn.
Through a long-sealed gate in Azshara. A corrupted furbolg city with multiple routes.
A titan facility in northern Un'Goro. Bring power crystals from the crater to its consoles.
Dungeon enemies give 50% more XP since Nov 9, and final bosses count toward Legacy points.
